title: Colt Canada industrial expansion on Wilson Avenue
subtitle: Also: missing-middle zoning at First Avenue, four condominium draft plans and two private street names.
overview: The committee's main item was a request from Colt Canada to change three Wilson Avenue properties from Low Rise Residential to General Industrial Employment. It recommended the Official Plan and zoning changes {{vote:m8}}. The company said the change supports expansion of an existing site and about 50 new jobs. Two vacant houses on the lands would be lost. Residents who spoke against it raised concerns about traffic, nearby natural features, noise and lighting.

The committee also recommended a zoning change at 75 First Avenue to allow low-rise missing-middle housing {{vote:m7}}. It recommended draft approval of four vacant-land condominium plans, at 1001 King Street East, 1198 Fischer Hallman Road with 1274 Bleams Road and 264 Erinbrook Drive, 15 Dellroy Avenue, and 455-509 Mill Street. It also acknowledged new private street names at two developments.

These are recommendations, so Council must still adopt them. The Wilson Avenue Official Plan change also needs approval from the Region of Waterloo. Site plan review will later address lighting, erosion control, tree protection and paving.

decisions.item: Wilson Avenue Official Plan and zoning change (Colt Canada)
decisions.detail: The committee recommended changing 1036, 1082 and 1094 Wilson Avenue from Low Rise Residential to General Industrial Employment, with the Official Plan amendment forwarded to the Region of Waterloo for approval.
The committee recommended approving a zoning by-law amendment to allow low-rise missing-middle intensification at 75 First Avenue.
The committee recommended draft approval of vacant-land condominium application 30CDM-24207, subject to conditions.

decisions.item: Condominium plan, Fischer Hallman, Bleams and Erinbrook
decisions.detail: The committee recommended draft approval of vacant-land condominium application 30CDM-24209 for 1198 Fischer Hallman Road, 1274 Bleams Road and 264 Erinbrook Drive, subject to conditions.
The committee recommended draft approval of vacant-land condominium application 30CDM-24210, subject to conditions.
The committee recommended draft approval of vacant-land condominium application 30CDM-24205, subject to conditions.

decisions.item: Private street names, 1000 New Dundee Road
decisions.detail: The committee acknowledged the proposed names Cachet Circle and Enclave Road and directed Legal Services to advertise and prepare the naming by-law.
The committee acknowledged the proposed name Cordoba Way and directed Legal Services to advertise and prepare the naming by-law.
